jobs.title: Lead Hospital Security Officer - Part Time
jobs.description:
The GEO Group, Inc. is seeking a Lead Hospital Officer in Houston to supervise detainees in a hospital setting under established procedures. This role requires strong leadership, adherence to security protocols, and coordinating with hospital and GEO teams.

You will uphold safety, follow restraint protocols, and complete required paperwork while respecting contracts and applicable laws. The position supports GEO's mission to deliver rehabilitation services.
